2. Go to the Organizations page.
3. Open the organization Testing.
4. Click on Edit.
5. Turn OFF the "SIF Conversion" toggle.
6. Click on Save.
7. Log out and log in as divya.d@riverstonetech.com (password River@123), a user of Testing.
8. Check the side menu and open the SIF Conversion URL directly.
9. (Clean-up) Turn the toggle ON again.

TC_SIF_079.expectedResult: The toggle saves as OFF, "SIF Conversion" is hidden from the side menu of that organization's users, opening the SIF Conversion URL directly is blocked with an access message, and other organizations are not affected (their SIF Conversion setting is unchanged).

TC_SIF_081.description: Verify the reason and Retry button of a failed file.
TC_SIF_081.preconditions: Logged in as divya.d@riverstonetech.com (organization Testing); SIF Conversion page open
TC_SIF_081.steps:
1. Observe the failed file.
2. Hover the "Failed" status.
TC_SIF_081.expectedResult: The failed file shows a "Retry" button and the reason "This PDF could not be read. It may be password-protected, damaged, or too large (max 100 pages)."
